title: 第9章 接引飞艇
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
加尔那身墨绿罩袍早已出现在巫师塔门口，几只触腕在雾气中缓慢摆动。

    他缓步走下石阶，朝广场中央走来。

    “很好，来得很早。”加尔的声音依旧是那种冰冷的质感，但仔细听，能察觉到一丝隐藏得极好的期待。

    他走到伊森面前，兜帽的阴影对准他，停留了一瞬。

    “等吧，船马上就来了。”

    加尔说完，几只触腕同时缩回袍内，他就那样安静地站在伊森身侧，仰头望向天际。

    雾气渐散，天色渐亮。

    伊森顺着加尔的目光望去，只见东方的天空泛起鱼肚白，几颗残星正在缓缓隐去。

    然后，

    他看到了。

    天边出现了一个极小的黑点。

    那黑点移动的速度快得惊人，仅仅几个呼吸间，就扩大到了肉眼可辨的程度。

    是一艘船。

    一艘悬浮在空中的船。

    船身通体惨白，如同由无数根骨骼拼接而成。船首是一个巨大的骷髅头骨，空洞的眼眶里燃烧着幽绿色的火焰。船身两侧延伸出数十根肋骨状的支架，每根支架末端都悬浮着一团跳动的磷火。

    船底没有桨，没有帆，没有任何可见的推进装置，但它就是那样平稳地、快速地滑过天际，朝着巫师塔的方向驶来。

    伊森的瞳孔微微收缩。

    这就是巫师学院的接引飞艇？

    加尔依旧站在原地，几只触腕不自觉地探出袍外，微微颤抖着。

    飞艇在广场上空缓缓下降。

    离地面还有约莫三十米时，一道惨白的光芒从船底落下，在地面形成一个直径约十米的光圈。

    光芒散去。

    一个身影出现在光圈中央。

    那是一个，骷髅。

    一具完整的、站立着的人类骷髅。骨骼呈现出象牙般的质感，表面流转着淡淡的银色纹路。

    空洞的眼眶里燃烧着两团幽绿的火焰。

    骷髅穿着黑色袍服，身上披着一件漆黑的斗篷，斗篷边缘绣着银色的骨纹。

    它右手握着一根同样由骨骼制成的法杖，法杖顶端镶嵌着一枚拳头大小的幽绿色晶石，晶石内部有无数细微的光芒在缓慢旋转。

    “吾乃学院灵骨守卫。”

    骷髅开口了。

    那声音直接在在场每个人的精神层面响起，“加尔何在？”

    加尔的身形微微一僵。

    那几只原本缩在袍内的触腕，如同受惊的蛇一般全部探出，却又在瞬间强行收回。

    他上前几步，墨绿罩袍的下摆在石板地面上拖出轻微的摩擦声。

    “守卫大人，我在这里。”
content_en:
Gar's dark green robe had already appeared at the door of the wizard's tower, with several tentacles swinging slowly in the mist.

    He slowly walked down the stone steps and walked towards the center of the square.

    "Very good, you came early." Gal's voice still had that cold quality, but if you listen carefully, you can detect a trace of well-hidden expectation.

    He walked up to Ethan, the shadow of the hood pointed at him, and stayed for a moment.

    "Wait, the ship will be here soon."

    After Gal finished speaking, several tentacles retracted into his robe at the same time. He stood quietly beside Ethan, looking up at the sky.

    The fog gradually dispersed and the sky became brighter.

    Ethan followed Gal's gaze and saw that the sky in the east was turning white, and a few remaining stars were slowly disappearing.

    Then,

    He saw it.

    A tiny black spot appeared on the horizon.

    The black spot moved at an alarming speed. In just a few breaths, it expanded to the point where it was visible to the naked eye.

    It's a ship.

    A ship suspended in the air.

    The hull of the ship is pale white, as if it is made up of countless bones. At the bow of the ship is a huge skull, with green flames burning in its empty eye sockets. Dozens of rib-like brackets extend from both sides of the hull, and a ball of beating phosphorus fire is suspended at the end of each bracket.

    There were no oars, no sails, and no visible propulsion device on the bottom of the ship, but it just slid across the sky smoothly and quickly, heading towards the Wizard Tower.

    Ethan's pupils shrank slightly.

    Is this the wizard academy's pick-up airship?

    Gal still stood there, a few tentacles unconsciously sticking out of his robe, trembling slightly.

    The airship descended slowly over the square.

    When it was still about thirty meters above the ground, a pale light fell from the bottom of the ship, forming a circle of light about ten meters in diameter on the ground.

    The light faded.

    A figure appeared in the center of the aperture.

    That's one, a skeleton.

    A complete, standing human skeleton. The bones have an ivory-like texture, with faint silver veins flowing on the surface.

    Two green flames burned in the empty eye sockets.

    The skeleton was wearing a black robe and a dark cloak with silver bone patterns embroidered on the edges.

    It holds a staff in its right hand that is also made of bone. The top of the staff is inlaid with a fist-sized dark green crystal. There are countless tiny lights inside the crystal that are slowly rotating.

    "I am the spiritual bone guard of the academy."

    The skeleton spoke.

    That voice sounded directly in the spiritual level of everyone present, "Where is Gal?"

    Gal's figure stiffened slightly.

    The few tentacles that were originally shrunk in the robe were all stretched out like frightened snakes, but they were forcefully retracted in an instant.

    He took a few steps forward, and the hem of his dark green robe made a slight friction sound on the stone floor.

    "Master Guard, I'm here."
